Author: River Zola
Name: Pingway Boards
Punchline: Read the Pingway Boards in game: statics, Free Companies and community events.
Description:
Shows the three Pingway Boards from pingway.app in an in-game window: Static recruitment (looking for members / looking for a static), FC recruitment (looking for members / looking for an FC) and Community events, with the same filters as the website.

Read-only and text only: to sign up, recruit or invite, use "View full poster", which opens the poster on pingway.app in your browser after a warning. The plugin only reads the public Boards feed from pingway.app; no login, no game automation.

Open it with /pboards. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix.
